rows.grounds: locative plural masculine of etad plus ādi in fused sandhi form
optative third singular active of yuj in causative sense

items.question: Should praṇava be joined to these first mantras?
premises: First mantras are specified by etadādyeṣu.
Praṇava is the object not joined.
items.inference: Therefore praṇava should not be joined to these first mantras.
uncertainties: Exact scope of the first mantras is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: In these first mantras, one should not join praṇava.
